title: Mandatory Full Dress Rehearsal & Academic Stole Distribution
summary: Full Dress Rehearsal is scheduled on Saturday, December 27, 2025 at 09:00 AM sharp in the Main Auditorium. Participation is mandatory for degree conferral on stage. Academic stoles will be issued against Institute ID from 08:00 AM to 12:00 PM.

title: Final List of Eligible Degree Recipients (UG, PG & Ph.D) for 14th Convocation
summary: The verified list of 985 graduating students (738 B.Tech/B.Arch, 111 M.Tech/MURP/M.Arch, and 136 Ph.D scholars) cleared by the Senate has been published. Please verify your Hindi and English name spellings in the Graduate Directory.

title: Security Guidelines & Campus Entry Protocol for Accompanying Parents / Guests
summary: Due to the august presence of Hon'ble Chief Minister of Bihar Shri Nitish Kumar (Chief Guest), strictly one parent/guardian pass will be permitted per degree recipient. Pre-registration of guest identity proof is mandatory by Dec 24.

title: Live Webcast & Virtual Telecast Details for XIV Convocation
summary: The complete proceedings of the 14th Convocation Ceremony will be broadcast live in High Definition on the official Institute YouTube Channel and NITP Webcast portal starting at 02:00 PM on December 27, 2025.
